label: thm:ground-graphs-neutral
proof_minimally_needs: A unitary map between a line in one sector and a line in the other. The graph of plus or minus that map is neutral for the indefinite form, and maximal neutral in the two-dimensional plane the lines span. Uniqueness, cyclicity and energy of the selected vectors are not used.
realization_supplies: The bridge-selected orientation between the physical and luminous ground lines.
basis: Statement and proof read; the minimal hypothesis was pointed out by the first reviewer.

label: def:momentary-phenomenal-system
proof_minimally_needs: A sequence of Hilbert spaces, each with a selected rank-one projection, states, and completely positive trace-preserving maps between consecutive moments.
realization_supplies: The luminous ground projection at each moment.

label: prop:exact-realization-absorbing
proof_minimally_needs: Covariance of the selected projections under the maps: each map sends the selected projection to the next one. Any selected pure reference states will do.
realization_supplies: Ground covariance of the luminous ground projections.

label: thm:momentary-ground-stabilization
proof_minimally_needs: Covariance as above, a contraction inequality for the deviation from the selected projection, and the pure-state Fuchs-van de Graaf inequality. Any selected pure reference states will do.
realization_supplies: The luminous ground projections and a stipulated contraction.
interpretation: Stabilization of realization along a continuum.
